settings.downloadPacingHelp: Adds small random delays between downloads so a large batch doesn't hit Deezer as one burst, reducing the chance your account gets flagged for unusual activity. Off keeps full speed; Balanced spaces downloads moderately; Cautious is slowest and safest. For the most natural pattern, pair Cautious with 1 concurrent download.

settings.skipDuplicateTracks: Skip tracks already in my library
settings.skipDuplicateTracksHelp: Before downloading, skip any recording you already have (matched by ISRC), even if it's from a different album or playlist. Tracks with no ISRC are always downloaded. Off by default.
settings.resumeInterruptedOnStartupHelp: If a download was still in progress when you last closed the app, automatically continue it the next time you open the app. Already-downloaded tracks are skipped, so it picks up where it left off. Only runs once you're logged in. Off by default.

settings.createAlbumPlaylistFile: Also create one for each album
settings.createAlbumPlaylistFileHelp: Writes an .m3u8 into every album folder as well as for playlists. A playlist needs its file because nothing else records the ordering and selection, but an album folder plus its tags already say the same thing. Leave this off if you import into Navidrome, MusicBee or similar, where each album file is picked up as a separate playlist.

tags.title: Title
tags.replayGainHelp: Writes Deezer's reference loudness into the file's tags so ReplayGain-aware players (foobar2000, VLC, most car and USB head units) level playback to match in-app volume. Metadata only — the audio is never modified. Because those players honor the tag, files can sound quieter than the same track from tools that don't write it. Turn this off if you want every file to play at raw volume.
tags.releaseTypeHelp: Marks each release as Album, Single, EP, or Compilation so music servers like Navidrome can group them separately. The value comes from Deezer (EP detection is best-effort).

qobuz.title: Qobuz
qobuz.description: Connect your Qobuz account to download hi-res FLAC (up to 24-bit/192 kHz). A paid Qobuz plan is required; free accounts can't download.
qobuz.help: A Qobuz login window opens; sign in normally. Your session token is stored encrypted and refreshes when you reconnect.
qobuz.tokenHelp: For accounts that only have an authentication token (for example, from another tool’s configuration) or when the login window is unavailable. The token is validated with Qobuz, then stored encrypted — exactly like the login-window flow. It never appears in settings files, exports, or backups.
qobuz.advancedHelp: If your token was created by another tool (streamrip, qobuz-dl, etc.), paste that tool's App ID and App Secret here too, and your User ID if you have it. Qobuz binds tokens to the app that made them, so this makes a token from elsewhere work. Leave blank for a normal token.
qobuz.disclaimer: Requires your own active paid Qobuz account. This app is not affiliated with Qobuz. Please follow Qobuz's terms of service.

settings.deezerDisclaimer: Use your own Deezer account. This app is not affiliated with Deezer. Please follow Deezer's terms of service.
